name: Margin-conf fusion + mode-adaptive stability
tagline: KLASS-style ready-set decoding with a confidence-times-margin fallback score, swapping KL stability for argmax-consistency in fully parallel mode.
init_recovers: KLASS baseline in semi-AR mode (block_length < gen_length)
diff_from_baseline: Replaces KLASS's confidence-only fallback with a confidence x margin fusion score, and swaps the KL stability test for an argmax-consistency counter when running fully parallel (block_length == gen_length).

name: Regime-adaptive ready set (TADS)
tagline: KLASS plus margin gating with stricter AND ready-rule for semi-AR and looser OR rule for parallel; ranking weights confidence vs margin shift over time.
init_recovers: KLASS when margin_thresh=0, ready_rule='AND', and weights are fixed to confidence
diff_from_baseline: Adds a margin gate alongside KLASS's confidence/KL ready set, requires AND in semi-AR but only OR in fully parallel mode, and linearly interpolates conf-vs-margin score weights across global progress, plus optional Gumbel sampling.

name: KLASS + parallel Gumbel margin
tagline: Strict KLASS for semi-AR; in fully-parallel mode add Gumbel-perturbed margin top-up and force-unmask remaining masks at the last step.

key_hyperparams.name: parallel_gumbel_temp
key_hyperparams.role: implicit token sampling temp in parallel mode

init_recovers: KLASS in semi-AR mode (semi-AR has no Gumbel injection)
diff_from_baseline: Inherits KLASS's stable/confident ready set but in fully parallel decoding switches to Gumbel-perturbed token sampling and Gumbel-perturbed margin ranking for unmasking diversity, and forcibly fills any leftover mask tokens at the final step.

name: Consensus + adaptive budget
tagline: Stability AND argmax-agreement run-counter, progress-relaxed thresholds, score blending conf/margin/agreement, with an adaptive transfer budget that grows when many positions look solved.

key_hyperparams.name: agree_bonus
key_hyperparams.role: added to score for argmax persistence

key_hyperparams.name: parallel_boost
key_hyperparams.role: transfer budget multiplier in fully parallel mode

init_recovers: KLASS-like behavior at progress=0 with no parallel boost and uniform transfer budget
diff_from_baseline: Strengthens KLASS by requiring both KL stability and argmax persistence (a run counter), relaxes the conf/margin gates with progress, blends conf/margin in the ranking score with stability/agreement bonuses, and lets the per-step budget grow when many positions are decisively solved.

name: Entropy + EMA stability
tagline: Replaces KL-history with KL to an EMA over distributions, gates on normalized entropy, and uses a weighted entropy/conf/margin/stability score for fallbacks.
init_recovers: Confidence-greedy fallback when entropy/stability gates are not satisfied
diff_from_baseline: Replaces KLASS's fixed KL window with KL against an exponential moving average of distributions, adds a normalized-entropy ready condition, makes the confidence gate decay with step/urgency, and uses a multi-term entropy/conf/margin/stability score for fallback ranking.
